tv: Thomson ATV R1 (SCBC, R1, Realtek), Russia
notes: TV stick on an SCBC Realtek board, 42 packages (five streaming apps the owner doesn't use ship commented out): the `com.apps.*` SCBC preload junk (S-Channel rows, TV Booster, esticker overlay, gdpr agent, speed-test, puresound, WorldClock, Wi-Fi hotspot), the Vewd store engine (asks CAMERA and RECORD_AUDIO), partner auto-installs and attribution, Google telemetry and recommendation rows, the Leanback launcher and its partner customizer; `com.google.android.tv.remote.service` kept, its AtvSearchAssistantService answers the mic button; `com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith` kept, the saved Wi-Fi network belongs to it and disabling it drops the TV off Wi-Fi and ADB (forget and re-join the network in Settings first, then it can go); `com.google.android.videos` kept, not asked about; the OTA updaters ship commented out (kept enabled) and this unit has them off at the owner's explicit request; the theme hides `com.rtk.engmenu` and the factory packages through library_excluded_apps, the library offers EngMenu as a plain tile and opening factory menus on these boards flips a flag adb cannot undo; reboot-checked; ADB on port 5555 closes by itself at boot once debugging is off in Developer options
